title.narrative: Bangladesh Environmental Sustainability and Transformation Project

description.narrative: Operation Abstract: Summary Description of Proposed Project The project will support the following four components: (a) environmental governance and infrastructure; (b) green financing for air pollution control; (c) vehicle emission control; and (d) e-waste management infrastructure.Component 1 (Revised cost: USD 144.23 million) : Environmental Governance and Infrastructure will support DOE to improve its environmental management capacity through (a) regulatory and policy reforms to reposition the regulatory mandate of DOE from action-oriented pollution control to goal-oriented protection and improvement of environmental quality and promotion of green growth; (b) institutional reforms to shift DOE's organizational structure towards specialization and decentralization with improved human and financial resources; and (c) capacity building to support DOE and its key stakeholders develop adequate technical capacity in environmental management and green growth; and (d) project management of DOE activities.Component 2 (Revised cost: USD 14.35 million): Green Financing for Air Pollution Control will support (a) the Bangladesh Bank (BB) to develop a green credit risk guarantee scheme to support targeted sectors to invest in green technologies to reduce air pollution discharges.Component 3 (Revised cost: USD 3.9 million): Vehicle Emission Control will support Bangladesh Road Transport Authority (BRTA) to develop its capacity in improving vehicle safety and control vehicle emission. The sub-component will support preparation and design work for physical activities to be taken up in the BCAP Phase 1 which include construction of vehicle inspection centers, and contract private sector operations to manage the operation and maintenance of such facilities.Component 4 (Revised USD 25 million): E-waste Management Infrastructure will support the Bangladesh High-tech Park Authority to develop a pilot e-waste management facility through a design-build-operate PPP arrangement to demonstrate technical, financial, environmental and social feasibility of e-waste management.
To strengthen the capacity of the Government of Bangladesh in environmental management and to pilot new financing mechanisms to promote green investments in targeted sectors.

condition.narrative: The Recipient shall establish and cause each of DOE, BB, BRTA and BHTPA to establish, within two (2) months of the Effective Date,and thereafter maintain throughout the course of Project implementation:(a) a Project implementation committee within the DOE,BB,BRTA and BHTPA, respectively, each such committee in accordance with section I.A.2 of schedule 2 of the FinancialAgreement(b) a Project Implementation Unit (PIU) within the DOE, BB, BRTA and BHTPA, respectively, each such unit in accordancewith section I.A.2 of schedule 2 of the Financial Agreement

The Recipient, through MOEFCC, shall establish within two (2) months of the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain throughout thecourse of Project implementation, a Project steering committee (“PSC”) in accordance with section I.A.1 of schedule 2 of theFinancial Agreement.
